Statechart for Alarm System:

1. Start
2. Idle
3. Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring
4. Blower Power Management Temperature Monitoring
5. Battery Temperature Monitoring
6. Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm
7. Blower Power Management Temperature Too High Alarm
8. Battery Temperature Too High Alarm
9. Safety Action Invocation
10. Battery Failure Alarm

Transitions:
- Start -> Idle
- Idle -> Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring
- Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring -> Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm
- Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm -> Idle
- Idle -> Blower Power Management Temperature Monitoring
- Blower Power Management Temperature Monitoring -> Blower Power Management Temperature Too High Alarm
- Blower Power Management Temperature Too High Alarm -> Idle
- Idle -> Battery Temperature Monitoring
- Battery Temperature Monitoring -> Battery Temperature Too High Alarm
- Battery Temperature Too High Alarm -> Idle
- Idle -> Safety Action Invocation
- Safety Action Invocation -> Idle
- Idle -> Battery Failure Alarm
- Battery Failure Alarm -> Idle

Guards:
- Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm: Temperature > Threshold
- Blower Power Management Temperature Too High Alarm: Temperature > Threshold
- Battery Temperature Too High Alarm: Temperature > Threshold
- Safety Action Invocation: Temperature > Threshold
- Battery Failure Alarm: Temperature > Threshold
